sources.role: Pinned source: Linux/Windows frontends, settings, keyboard matrices, ROMs, TAP and snapshot serializer.
Build/release boundary: Linux v1.0.9, Windows v1.0.8; master Windows caveat.
Settings, TAP/snapshot behavior and command-line paths.

paths.path: $HOME/.jynx_emulator/JynxEmulatorSettings.config; `--settings <path>` overrides it. UserSettingsSerialiser writes version-5 line-oriented text.
paths.naming: FileVersion, MachineType, RenderStyle, SoundEnable, FullScreenEnable, SpeedPercentage, TapeSounds, RemExtensions, MaxSpeedCassette, MaxSpeedConsole, MaxSpeedAlways, ColourSet; booleans 0/1.

paths.path: No persisted controller map. Linux_MainForm maps GDK hardware keycodes through a fixed 8x11 matrix; no joystick backend.
paths.naming: Source-defined arrows, Shift/Ctrl, letters, punctuation, Return, Backspace; HOME/END alias UP/DOWN.

paths.path: User-selected writable/readable Lynx TAP cassette media, not battery/NVRAM.
paths.naming: `.tap`; `--run <path>` loads startup tape; new output tape is saved to selected path.

paths.path: User-selected `.lynxsnapshot` or `--snapshot <path>`. Text snapshot excludes cassette state/media.
paths.naming: `<camputers_lynx>` version 1; machine 48/96/960, Z80, video/bank, ROM/RAM and four screen-RAM blocks; ROMs are included.

paths.path: ROM files loaded from executable/resource directory; no BIOS directory setting.
paths.naming: lynx48-1.rom, lynx48-2.rom, lynx96-1.rom, lynx96-2.rom, lynx96-3.rom, lynx96-3-scorpion.rom; 8192 bytes each.

evidence: source:Jynx tree has no key loader @a02560be8a9b6a13b3a5a33de7e032d8f86dc658

linux.notes: README identifies v1.0.9 as tested/released Linux; master Windows changes are not regression-tested.

paths.path: No persisted controller map. ForWindows/MainForm.cpp maps Win32 virtual-key codes through a fixed 8x11 matrix; no joystick backend.
paths.naming: Source-defined arrows, Shift/Ctrl, letters, punctuation, Return, Backspace; HOME/END alias UP/DOWN.

paths.path: User-selected writable/readable Lynx TAP media; no battery/NVRAM sidecar.
paths.naming: `.tap`; `--run <path>` loads at startup; output tapes use selected path.

paths.naming: `<camputers_lynx>` with machine 48/96/960, Z80, ROM/RAM and screen-RAM blocks.

paths.path: ROM files beside executable/resource directory, selected by machine type.

windows.notes: README states v1.0.8 is tested/released Windows; master builds but post-v1.0.8 changes are not regression-tested.

linux-flatpak.reason: No Flatpak manifest or app ID.

macos.reason: ForMacOS contains only a placeholder; no macOS frontend/build or runtime contract.
evidence: source:ForMacOS/This is where the MAC OS code would go.txt @a02560be8a9b6a13b3a5a33de7e032d8f86dc658

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a Jynx controller file. Linux/Windows consume fixed source-defined keyboard matrices; settings.config stores display/emulation options, not host key bindings.
